_readme: One entry per close-up photo of ONE component, cropped so the part fills most of the frame (as the app does). Put photos in test-set/photos/ (gitignored). If you also turn each crop so the part sits in its reference orientation (pin 1 top-left, cathode / + on the left), set markWhere to where the mark should be ('top-left', 'left', ...); the app does this automatically once the camera is calibrated. expected.verdict: ok | problem. expected.orientation: correct | wrong (polarized parts). expected.issue: flipped, missing, misaligned, wrong_part, tombstoned, bridged, insufficient_solder, excess_solder, cold_joint, lifted_lead, other. checkSoldering: false for solder-paste boards that are not reflowed yet. The two entries are examples: replace them with real photos.
